question: Who composed 'The Dashakumaracharita' or 'Tales of Ten Princes'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dandin.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dandin **composed **'The Dashakumaracharita' **or **'Tales of Ten Princes'.**
 
• The Dasakumaracarita relates the adventures of** ten princes** in their pursuit of love and royal power.
 
• It contains stories of common life.
 
• It reflects a faithful picture of Indian society during the period couched in the colorful style of Sanskrit prose.
 
• It was written by Dandin, a renowned Sanskrit author of prose romances and expounder on poetics. 
 
• Dandin was a court poet from **Vidarbha.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bhartrhari**

 
 
• Bhartṛhari is a **Hindu linguistic philosopher.**
 
• Bhartrihari's poetry is aphoristic and comments on the social mores of the time.
 
• The collected work is known as Śatakatraya "the three śatakas or 'hundreds' ('centuries')".
 
 
 
• **Budhasvamin**
 
 
• Budhasvamin was a** Sanskrit poet.**
 
• He is known as the author of the **Brhatkathaslokasamgraha.**
 
• His Sanskrit is polished and easy to understand.
 
 
 
• **Rahas Bihari Dwivedi**
 
 
• ​Rahas Bihari Dwivedi is a** Sanskrit scholar** and poet from Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh.
 
• He was awarded the President's Ceritificate of Honour for Sanskrit in the year 2012.
 
• He was the formerly the Head of the Department of Sanskrit at Rani Durgavati University, Jabalpur.
